Based on the official rules of Table Tennis, the app handles most match situations, such as Singles, Doubles, Intervals, Time-outs, Expedite System etc. If two devices with the app installed are available, one of them can act as a remote control.

The Scoreboard shows and allows to set and update all the data of the match: names and photos (optional) of players, serving order, score of the game in progress and the number of games won by each player / pair. Furthermore, it shows and manages the start and the end of games and match, ends changes and intervals. If the loudspeaker is active, the scores are announced by voice.

If is available a second device with the app installed, one can be used as scoreboard and the other as a remote control. All match data are recorded and saved on the device used as a scoreboard.

At the end of each match a summary is shown and can be shared. Furthermore, for each match the app records and saves many data: players, score and duration of each game, points scored, etc. Data of each match can be selected, viewed and shared. It is also possible to complete with the final score any matches interrupted and also manually add new matches that have not been “refereed” with the app. To highlight results and trends, match data can be shown in the form of charts in various formats: summary, single player, direct matches between two players, also in a given interval.
